name: Battle Collective (Psionic)
body:
During the initial clash of arms, your collective can include the first line of battle.

Prerequisite(s): Collective class feature, Expanded Collective feat

Benefit(s): You can, once per day, double the number of creatures in your collective for a number of rounds equal to your manifester level. Special: You can take this feat up to three times, increasing the number of times per day that you can double your collective by one each time.
